listing.name: Skylanders: Swap Force — tsapZ SwapForceRecomp (tsapZ)
listing.summary: The tutorial and Woodburrow are reported to work with swappers. Later sections and installation on a clean machine have not been tested. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PAL English/German Xbox 360 ISO or extracted folder for title 415608E9. The accepted default.xex fingerprint is dc58d3851bbd89935e9ecf2ee84b158ec400f049da46c937a4713477a50c79d7.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the release installer and import your own ISO. Games run as standalone native programs. The CoreOfLight hub and a real USB portal are optional; a virtual portal is supported. The Windows x64 player uses D3D12. Building from source requires VS2022 Clang, CMake, Ninja, just and Python.

warnings: The tutorial and Woodburrow are reported to work with swappers. Later sections and installation on a clean machine have not been tested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
